quests.instruction: Touch the body part that has your eyes, nose, and mouth on it!
quests.question: Face
quests.hint: You see this when you look in a mirror!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Face is the front of your head, with your eyes, nose, and mouth!
quests.funFact: Your face can make thousands of different expressions!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that turns pink when you feel shy or cold!
quests.question: Cheeks
quests.hint: You have two, one on each side of your face!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Cheeks are the soft round parts on the sides of your face!
quests.funFact: Your cheeks puff up with air when you blow a big bubble.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that bends right in the middle of your arm!
quests.question: Elbows
quests.hint: They are the bendy part in the middle of your arm!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Elbows are the bendy joints in the middle of your arms!
quests.funFact: Your elbows let your arms fold in half, like a hinge on a door!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that bends right where your foot meets your leg!
quests.question: Ankles
quests.hint: They are found where your foot meets your leg!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Ankles connect your feet to your legs and help you balance!
quests.funFact: Your ankles help you balance every time you stand on one foot!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part you press together gently to blow a kiss!
quests.question: Lips
quests.hint: They curve up when you smile!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Lips are the soft edges around your mouth that help you smile and talk!
quests.funFact: Your lips are much more sensitive to touch than most of your skin!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that you cannot see without a mirror!
quests.question: Back
quests.hint: It is the part of you facing away from a mirror!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Back is the part behind you that helps you stand up straight!
quests.funFact: Your back has a strong row of bones running down the middle called your backbone.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that sits above your eyebrows and below your hair!
quests.question: Forehead
quests.hint: It is the flat part above your eyebrows!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Forehead is the flat part of your face above your eyebrows!
quests.funFact: Your forehead can wrinkle up when you look surprised or confused.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that bends right in the middle of your leg!
quests.question: Knees
quests.hint: They are the bendy part in the middle of your leg!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Knees are the bendy joints in the middle of your legs!
quests.funFact: Your knees are the biggest, strongest joints in your whole body!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that grows along the edge of your eyelids!
quests.question: Eyelashes
quests.hint: They flutter every time you blink!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Eyelashes grow along your eyelids and help keep dust out of your eyes!
quests.funFact: Eyelashes work like tiny fans, sweeping away dust from your eyes!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part you raise up high when you feel surprised!
quests.question: Eyebrows
quests.hint: You have two, right above your eyes!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Eyebrows sit above your eyes and help keep sweat and rain out of them!
quests.funFact: Your eyebrows help keep sweat and rain out of your eyes!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part you point up high to show something is great!
quests.question: Thumbs
quests.hint: You point these up to say 'great job!'
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Thumbs help your hand grip things and can touch each of your other fingers!
quests.funFact: Your thumbs help your hands grip things tightly, like a cup or a pencil!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that bends right where your hand meets your arm!
quests.question: Wrists
quests.hint: They are found where your hand meets your arm!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Wrists connect your hands to your arms and let your hands turn and wave!
quests.funFact: Each of your wrists has eight tiny bones that help it bend!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that sits just below your mouth!
quests.question: Chin
quests.hint: It is at the very bottom of your face!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Chin is the part at the very bottom of your face, below your mouth!
quests.funFact: Humans are the only animals with a pointy chin like this!

quests.instruction: Point to the body part that lets your head nod, shake, and turn around!
quests.question: Neck
quests.hint: Here's a clue: It is between your head and your shoulders!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Neck connects your head to your shoulders and lets your head turn!
quests.funFact: Your neck works hard to hold up your head all day long!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part where you can feel your heart go thump, thump, thump!
quests.question: Chest
quests.hint: You can feel your heart beating right here!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Chest is the front of your upper body, where your heart and lungs are!
quests.funFact: Your chest holds two very important helpers: your heart and your lungs!

quests.instruction: Can you touch the body part you puff up big when you blow out candles?
quests.question: Cheeks
quests.hint: They puff up when you blow out birthday candles.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Cheeks are the soft round parts on the sides of your face!
quests.funFact: Babies often have extra round, chubby cheeks.

quests.instruction: Point to the body part that holds your brain safe inside, like a helmet made of bone!
quests.question: Head
quests.hint: Here's a clue: It is the very top part of you!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Head is the part on top of your neck that holds your brain and face!
quests.funFact: Your head makes up a big part of your whole body when you are a baby!

quests.instruction: Can you touch the body part you wash every morning to feel fresh?
quests.question: Face
quests.hint: Your eyes, nose, and mouth are all part of it.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Face is the front of your head, with your eyes, nose, and mouth!
quests.funFact: Smiling uses fewer muscles in your face than frowning.

quests.instruction: Can you touch the body part you bend to lean on the table while you eat your dinner?
quests.question: Elbows
quests.hint: You bend these to bring food to your mouth.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Elbows are the bendy joints in the middle of your arms!
quests.funFact: That funny, tingly feeling when you bump your elbow has a nickname: the funny bone.

quests.instruction: Can you touch the body part where you might wear a fun pair of socks?
quests.question: Ankles
quests.hint: Your socks cover these.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Ankles connect your feet to your legs and help you balance!
quests.funFact: Each ankle is made of several small bones working together.

quests.instruction: Can you touch the body part that curves up into a big happy smile?
quests.question: Lips
quests.hint: They are the soft edges around your mouth.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Lips are the soft edges around your mouth that help you smile and talk!
quests.funFact: Lips do not have the tiny glands that keep the rest of your skin moist.

quests.instruction: Point to the body part that keeps your head warm on a cold, snowy day!
quests.question: Hair
quests.hint: Here's a clue: You comb or brush this part every day!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Hair grows on top of your head and helps keep it warm!
quests.funFact: You have about one hundred thousand hairs growing on your head!

quests.instruction: Point to the body part you use to ride a bicycle around the block!
quests.question: Legs
quests.hint: Here's a clue: You have two, and you use them to walk!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Legs help you walk, run, and jump!
quests.funFact: Your two legs work together perfectly every time you ride a bike!

quests.instruction: Can you touch the body part we rest against a chair when we sit down?
quests.question: Back
quests.hint: Your backpack rests against this part.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Back is the part behind you that helps you stand up straight!
quests.funFact: A backpack should sit close to your back to feel light and comfy.

quests.instruction: Can you touch the body part you bend when you sit criss-cross on the floor?
quests.question: Knees
quests.hint: You bend these when you sit in a chair.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Knees are the bendy joints in the middle of your legs!
quests.funFact: You bend your knees every single time you sit down.

quests.instruction: Can you touch the body part that wrinkles up when you feel confused?
quests.question: Forehead
quests.hint: Your hair grows just above it.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Forehead is the flat part of your face above your eyebrows!
quests.funFact: A cool cloth on your forehead can help you feel better when you are warm.

quests.instruction: Find the body part we use to point at a pretty rainbow and touch it!
quests.question: Fingers
quests.hint: Think about this: You use these to point and count.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Fingers help you point, count, and pick up small things!
quests.funFact: You have ten fingers, and each one has its own fingerprint!

quests.instruction: Can you touch the body part that sits right above each of your eyes?
quests.question: Eyebrows
quests.hint: You raise these when you are surprised.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Eyebrows sit above your eyes and help keep sweat and rain out of them!
quests.funFact: You can make dozens of expressions just by moving these.

quests.instruction: Can you touch the body part where you might wear a cozy bracelet or watch?
quests.question: Wrists
quests.hint: A watch or bracelet wraps around these.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Wrists connect your hands to your arms and let your hands turn and wave!
quests.funFact: Your wrists let your hands twist, wave, and turn easily.

quests.instruction: Can you touch the body part you blink to keep dust out of your eyes?
quests.question: Eyelashes
quests.hint: They grow along the edge of your eyelids.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Eyelashes grow along your eyelids and help keep dust out of your eyes!
quests.funFact: You have upper and lower eyelashes on every eye.
